parts.name: Base plate
parts.role: Carries everything; held down at four screw points.

parts.name: Left slider
parts.role: Slides in to lock the housing to the base, no tools.

parts.name: Right slider
parts.role: The same, on the other side.

parts.name: Housing
parts.role: Encloses the LEDs and the electronics from outside light.

parts.name: LED holder
parts.role: Holds the 24 LEDs in their sockets on the 18 mm grid.

parts.name: Tube holder
parts.role: Holds each tube over its own LED; black, 4 wall loops, to stop light crossing.

parts.name: Perf board (bought)
parts.role: Carries the three MOSFETs under the LED holder.
